[i554] Another try to prevent NPEs on IBM J9
addendum to previous commit; found hardcoded reference to an added field and it is safer to now use the augment class to access that field.

Finished refactor of FieldAugment; there's no longer a separate variant for boolean and references, and the code no longer blows up with a bunch of NPEs if you try to use the reference variant (which is now the only variant) with a primitive type.

Should have zero effect on features or bugs, 100% refactor.
[#688] Bugfix for eclipse: syntax highlighting would break amongst many other features if using @Setter and most other features.
bugfixed ‘print build time as part of version number if edge release’ feature.
Fixed up and extended Tolerate with support for constructors, and added docs.
fixed up ‘consequent boolean’ proposal with a different key name and documentation.

Revert "Remove a wrong test for copyAnnotations returning empty array."

While Maaartinus' thoughts are obviously correct (far better to use an empty array to convey 'this list-like construct has 0 items in it right now', vs. a null pointer),
eclipse actually uses null-as-empty almost everywhere, and a lot of eclipse code will simply break if you don't do it right.

This reverts commit 842a4759165c5cd05aae63da3921ee11a3641a4b.
Fix a trivial bug in generateNullCheck.
Implement Tolerate.
Create GETTER_CONSEQUENT_BOOLEAN.
Remove a wrong test for copyAnnotations returning empty array.

removed out of date docs that we don’t use, and updated the download link to our own server.
more work on lombok.config resolution issues. Mostly turning outright showstopping errors in workarounds and logs, because we can't reproduce any of it.
